notes: Preflight every call with get_cost:true and stop when balance < next video cost.

Wave B (07-14) and video 15 run through Marketing Studio: first create the SneakersFest product entity via show_marketing_studio action='create' with brand imagery, then generate with the listed preset_slug and hook_id.
All other videos are direct generate_video calls with the listed model/prompt.
hook_id values reference Higgsfield's preset hook library (verified 2026-07-08).
To downgrade any premium video to budget, swap model to kling3_0_turbo, duration 10, and drop the preset/hook (use the prompt field).

videos.title: The Drop Heard Everywhere
videos.prompt: Cinematic night sky over a city; a single premium sneaker falls in dramatic slow motion and lands on a wet street with a glowing shockwave rippling outward; crowds turn their heads; the sneaker glows on the pavement; end on bold logo text 'SNEAKERSFEST' with date placeholder. Moody teal-and-orange grade, bass-drop sound design, no dialogue. Frame-1 overlay text: 'Something is landing in your city.'

videos.title: One Million Laces
videos.prompt: Extreme macro of a sneaker lace pulled taut; camera pulls back continuously to reveal thousands of interlaced laces weaving into a giant aerial logo reading 'SNEAKERSFEST'; hard cut to black, date sting. Voiceover: 'One city. One weekend. Every sneaker that ever mattered.' Frame-1 overlay: 'Every pair tells a story. We're bringing all of them.'

videos.title: Museum Break-In
videos.prompt: Dark museum at night, alarm light strobes; a glass display case lights up revealing a grail sneaker rotating on a plinth; the case opens by itself, the sneaker floats out, museum doors burst open to festival crowd noise and light. Overlay text frame 1: 'Grails don't belong behind glass.' End text: 'SneakersFest.'

videos.title: City Takeover
videos.prompt: City billboard, bus stop screen and metro display all glitch simultaneously into sneaker silhouettes; sneakerheads on the street look up; streets fill with people; aerial shot of the crowd forming a sneaker outline. High-energy drill beat, cuts on the snare. Frame-1 overlay: 'Your city is about to get laced.'

videos.title: Heartbeat
videos.prompt: Pitch black screen with a loud heartbeat; each beat flashes a different iconic sneaker for a few frames; flashes accelerate; the heartbeat morphs into a crowd stomping in unison; white flash to 'SNEAKERSFEST' logo. Sound-design led, no dialogue. Frame-1 overlay: 'You'll feel it before you see it.'

videos.title: The Queue
videos.prompt: Time-lapse of an empty dawn street filling with a camp-out queue stretching to the horizon: tents, folding chairs, sneaker boxes used as pillows; sunrise; venue gates crack open and a rush of fresh sneakers floods in. Frame-1 overlay: 'POV: it's the night before SneakersFest.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Product Hit
videos.prompt: Creator talking to camera gets bonked by a flying sneaker box mid-sentence, recovers and pivots into announcing SneakersFest: dates, venue, why it can't be missed. Caption overlay: 'I got hit by the news too.' CTA: 'Dates in bio before they sell out.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Product Dodge
videos.prompt: A sneaker rockets at the creator's face; they duck, pop back up already holding it and deadpan: 'Caught it. Like you should catch these SneakersFest tickets before resale does.' Overlay: 'These are launching. Literally.' CTA: 'Comment a sneaker emoji for the drop list.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Epic Fail
videos.prompt: Creator attempts a backflip, falls flat, sits up and immediately pitches SneakersFest without pausing: 'That hurt less than missing SneakersFest would.' Overlay: 'The only L I'm taking this year.' CTA: 'Don't take the L — link in bio.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Camera Bump
videos.prompt: Camera operator bumps the creator's forehead; during recovery the camera pans down revealing an exclusive festival colorway on-feet. Creator: 'Since you're looking: fest-exclusive. Only way to get them is to be there.' Overlay: 'Wait for the reveal.' CTA: 'Save this so you don't forget the date.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Sneaker Mic
videos.prompt: During a casual vlog a sneaker drops from above into the creator's hand; they instantly use it as a microphone for a dead-serious breaking-news announcement about SneakersFest: every major reseller, brand and legend in one building. Overlay: 'Breaking news, live from my kitchen.' CTA: 'Share this with your plug.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Street Interview
videos.prompt: Street interviewer asks a stranger a question based on the previous stranger's random answer; confusion builds until they notice the sneakers and pivot: 'Is that the thing with the sneaker mountain? I'm going.' Overlay: 'We asked strangers what SneakersFest is…' CTA: 'Would YOU know the answer? Comments.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Blizzard
videos.prompt: A cozy room with a sneaker shelf is hit by a violent impossible indoor blizzard; chaos everywhere but the sneakers stay pristine; storm stops, creator: 'Rain, snow, or resale prices — SneakersFest is happening.' Overlay: 'Nothing stops the rotation.' CTA: 'Follow — venue reveal this week.'

videos.title: UGC Hook — Product Crash
videos.prompt: A sneaker box crashes from above destroying the scene; hard cut to a perfectly clean restored room where the creator calmly lists everything dropping at SneakersFest. Overlay: 'Deleted my whole setup for this announcement.' CTA: 'Which drop are you camping for?'

videos.title: Virtual Try-On — Grail Rotation
videos.prompt: Feet-down POV: sneakers morph between five grail colorways with each finger snap, snap SFX and beat switch per colorway. Overlay: 'Try on the whole fest before you arrive.' CTA: 'Which pair? Vote in comments.'

videos.title: Lace-Up ASMR
videos.prompt: Extreme macro ASMR: fingers thread a lace through a sneaker eyelet, tongue pull, heel pop, sole tap on wood floor, box lid slides open revealing a festival ticket inside. Crisp tactile audio, shallow depth of field. Overlay: 'The most satisfying 10 seconds of your day.' CTA: 'Sound on.'

videos.title: On-Feet Check POV
videos.prompt: First-person POV stepping out of a car, camera tilts down as fresh sneakers hit the pavement outside a festival venue, walking through gates into a sea of on-feet shots and crowds. Overlay: 'POV: you chose the right weekend.' CTA: 'Tag who's walking in with you.'

videos.title: Rate the Rotation
videos.prompt: Rapid-fire on-feet closeups of wildly different sneaker pairs with judge-style score graphics slamming on screen: 9.1, 6.4, 10. Overlay: 'Judges will be at SneakersFest. Will your pair survive?' Voiceover: 'Bring your best pair. We're rating rotations live.' CTA: 'Drop your rotation below.'

videos.title: Sneaker Mountain Reveal
videos.prompt: A towering wall of stacked sneaker boxes collapses toward the camera, freezes mid-fall, then the camera pulls back to reveal a mountain-sized sneaker-box installation inside a festival hall, crowds tiny at its base. Rumble and choir sting. Overlay: 'We built a mountain out of grails.' CTA: 'See it in person.'

videos.title: 72 Hours Countdown
videos.prompt: A giant digital countdown projected on a city building ticks under 72:00:00 while night traffic blurs past; people film it on phones; tickets scan at turnstiles; gates open. Tense ticking score. Overlay: '72 hours until the doors open.' CTA: 'Set a reminder. Now.'

videos.title: Sold Out Simulator
videos.prompt: Screen recording style: a ticket checkout page where the BUY button greys out to SOLD OUT while the cursor hovers; the cursor circles helplessly. Overlay: 'This is you on Friday if you scroll past.' Voiceover: 'Last year's passes went in hours. This year there are more of you.' CTA: 'Don't be the cursor.'

videos.title: The Group Chat
videos.prompt: Phone screen closeup: a group chat explodes with dozens of messages in seconds, all sneaker emojis and 'TICKETS??'; one friend posts a pass QR code; every avatar's status flips to a sneaker emoji. Overlay: 'Your group chat in 3…2…' CTA: 'Screenshot this into your group chat.'

videos.title: Last Pair
videos.prompt: A single sneaker on a lit pedestal in a vast dark warehouse; overhead lights shut off row by row approaching it; final light flickers. Voiceover: 'When it's gone, it's gone.' Overlay: 'Everything at the fest is limited. Including your excuses.' CTA: 'Early passes — link in bio.'

videos.title: What's Inside — Rapid Tour
videos.prompt: A door is kicked open; hyperspeed dolly shot flies through festival halls: sneaker trading floor, live customization lab with airbrush artists, basketball court, street-food row, concert stage — each world a distinct color grade. Overlay: '8 seconds. 5 worlds. 1 ticket.' CTA: 'Full map in bio.'

videos.title: Customization Lab
videos.prompt: Macro slow motion: an airbrush hits a blank white sneaker and vivid color blooms across the leather; artist hands rotate the shoe; finished 1-of-1 held up to festival lights. Voiceover: 'Live customization lab. Your design, your pair, made at the fest.' Overlay: 'Walk in with a blank. Walk out with a 1-of-1.' CTA: 'Book a lab slot.'

videos.title: Trading Floor Energy
videos.prompt: Two collectors slap hands over a table stacked with grail sneakers; the surrounding crowd erupts; boxes swap; wide shot of an endless wall of trade tables under warm light. Overlay: 'Where deals become legends.' CTA: 'Bring your heat. Trading floor passes in bio.'

videos.title: Night Stage
videos.prompt: Festival night stage: a DJ silhouette raises a glowing sneaker overhead instead of their hands; the beat drops with pyro bursts and a jumping crowd in sneaker-brand tees. Overlay: 'The fest doesn't sleep.' CTA: 'Lineup announcement — follow so you don't miss it.'

videos.title: You Watched Them All — Retarget
videos.prompt: A mosaic grid of many short sneaker-festival clips playing simultaneously collapses inward into a single glowing festival ticket. Voiceover: 'Stop watching trailers. Start packing.' Overlay: 'You've seen enough. You're coming.' CTA: 'Get your pass — link in bio.'

videos.title: Price Anchor
videos.prompt: A grail sneaker on a turntable with a resale price counter spinning upward wildly; smash cut to a festival pass with a small static price. Voiceover: 'One pass. Every brand, every drop, every legend.' Overlay: 'Costs less than the laces on your grails.' CTA: 'Passes from launch price — this week only.'

videos.title: See You There — Closer
videos.prompt: Empty festival venue at dawn, dust in the light beams, a single pair of sneakers center floor; massive doors boom open, light floods in, crowd noise swells; cut to black with logo. Voiceover: 'SneakersFest. See you on the floor.' Overlay: 'The floor is waiting.' CTA: 'Final call — link in bio.'
